component.name: EPUBShelf
component.summary: EPUB library manager organized by series

description.p: EPUBShelf is a desktop application for managing and organizing your EPUB ebook collection by series, with automatic metadata extraction, cover art, reading progress tracking, and intelligent search.

Features include recursive EPUB scanning with a localStorage cache, metadata extraction (title, author, series state), a series grid with dominant-tint coloring and reading progress bars, a volume detail view with read/unread/pending status tracking, fuzzy search (Ctrl+K), smart sorting, dark and light themes, a statistics dashboard, and persistent state management.

screenshot.caption: Series grid with cover art, reading progress, and tinted cards
Volume detail view with per-volume status tracking

ul.li: Volume cover preview — hovering or tabbing to a volume thumbnail floats the full-size cover above the list, keeping each cover's own proportions.

Bandua Studio branding — the loading screen carries the Pixel Arc, and the About modal was rebuilt with the studio identity, social profiles, support links with copy-to-clipboard, and explorer links for the wallet addresses.
New application icon, dark-dominant so it stays legible at taskbar sizes.
Bandua palette throughout — Deep, Mist and Teal replace every hardcoded purple and blue.
Renamed the product to EPUBShelf (was BibliotecaEpub).
About modal with system information and credits.
External links open in the default browser instead of inside the Electron container.
Removed the default Electron menu bar.
Light theme toggle with persistent localStorage and an anti-flash script.
Statistics dashboard — summary cards, state breakdown, largest series, and 30-day activity, all pure CSS/SVG.
WCAG fixes — button and badge contrast, detail view tint gradient.
Windows builds — NSIS installer and portable executable.
Multi-language interface (PT/EN) with automatic system language detection.
